interest: Wartime League narcotics reports, forwarded by State to Treasury.
overview: September 12, 1942 note from the Secretary of State transmitting Bechuanaland's 1941 opium and dangerous drugs report to the Treasury.

subfiles.about: The Secretary of State transmits the 1941 annual report of the Bechuanaland Protectorate on the traffic in opium and dangerous drugs to the Secretary of the Treasury.
subfiles.summary: On September 12, 1942, State sends Treasury the Bechuanaland Protectorate's 1941 report on opium and dangerous drugs, with copies for Narcotics and Customs.
subfiles.title: Transmittal of Bechuanaland 1941 annual report on dangerous drugs to Secretary of the Treasury
